mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger equity sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a severe economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a federal funds rate above 0.5% per annum signals aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS > 0.5, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 5% signals weakening residential demand, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls > 5%, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls > 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 0.5% monthly growth signals strong consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS growth > 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.0%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 100,000 jobs signals worsening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0 and PAYEMS falls > 100,000, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.
